title: AquaTerra in June 2023: {count} drives, from plantings to origami
description: June 2023 at AquaTerra: {count} drives, six planting runs in Kolkata, origami and art sessions, yoga, dance, a dental camp and a Sundarbans planting day.
lede: In June 2023 AquaTerra ran {count} drives across {placesCount} places, with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts. The month was made of three kinds of work: six planting runs in Kolkata, a long run of art and origami sessions, and dance, yoga and speaking workshops for children. A Sundarbans planting day and a dental camp sat alongside them.

sections.heading: six planting drives in Kolkata
body: Grow Green ran as a numbered series through June, from Plantation Drive 6.0 on June 2 to 11.0 on June 30. All six were in Kolkata, and each one planted around a hundred saplings.

Each One Plant One joined the run from drive 8.0 onward, on June 7, 23, 24 and 30. The Sundarbans Plantation Project 4.0 on June 10 went to the Sundarbans villages, with twelve volunteers, and combined planting with health checkups.

sections.heading: origami, art and craft across many places
body: Art and craft was the largest group of the month. Origami Days was a summer camp at Gyandeepak on June 5, with twelve volunteers. Art in Folds, an origami workshop at Universal Smile, ran on June 2, and Wings of Paper, another origami workshop, ran at A Little Contribution on June 17.

Drawing and painting came next: Ink your Tee, a T-shirt painting workshop at Pather Sathi on June 3, Art Therapy at Hope Foundation on June 9, Art in Motion at Pather Sathi on June 10, Soul Sketch at Pather Sathi on June 24, Sketch Stories at Anukur Shiksha Sadan on June 29, and Art Attack, a drawing competition at National Hindi High School on June 30.

sections.heading: nature, English and speaking
body: Nature x English ran as three days spread across three weeks: Day 1 at Ek Tara on June 16, Day 2 at Ek Tara on June 23, and Day 3 at Pather Sathi on June 30. Day 3 turned trees into metaphors and silence into storytelling.

Speak and Spell, an English workshop at Pather Sathi on June 9, and the second day of Speak to Shine at School on Wheels HUHT on June 22 finished the language work. Speak to Shine's first day had been in May.

sections.heading: dance, yoga and singing
body: Three movement sessions ran in June. Move and Groove, a dance workshop at Sree Sree Gauranga Gaudiya Mission Sevashram on June 6, was followed by Step to Sound, singing and dancing at Telltula Ashram on June 8. Pose and Peace, a yoga workshop at Badami Devi Shishu Kalyan Kendra in Howrah, closed the set on June 23.
Art in Motion, a drawing and dancing workshop at Pather Sathi on June 10, joined the same run. The Pride Binge fundraiser on June 22 in Kolkata was a celebration of stories, laughter and solidarity.

sections.heading: a dental camp, food for all and the shelter visits
body: Tooth Talk, a dental camp at Ek Tara on June 14, gave checkups and tooth-care tips. Food For All was a food donation drive on June 24 during Rath Yatra in Kolkata, serving meals and food packets on the day.
Respect and Reach drive 5.0 visited the Urban Shelter for the Homeless on June 2, and the stray dog series reached Tails and Treats 17.0 on June 3 in Kolkata.

learnings: A numbered run in one city keeps a month simple: six planting drives in Kolkata gave the team one plan to repeat.
Each One Plant One joined the planting run from drive 8.0 onward, which shows how a collaboration can grow in the middle of a series.
Origami ran as a summer camp and as two workshops in June, which shows how one craft can take different shapes.
Movement sessions travel well: dance, yoga and singing ran at a sevashram, an ashram and a centre in Howrah.

faqs.q: How many saplings did AquaTerra plant in June 2023?
faqs.a: Six Grow Green planting drives ran in Kolkata in June 2023, from 6.0 on June 2 to 11.0 on June 30, and each one planted around a hundred saplings. The Sundarbans Plantation Project 4.0 on June 10 also included planting, with twelve volunteers.

faqs.q: Does AquaTerra run origami workshops for children?
faqs.a: Yes. In June 2023 AquaTerra ran origami at a summer camp at Gyandeepak on June 5, with twelve volunteers. It also ran Art in Folds at Universal Smile on June 2 and Wings of Paper at A Little Contribution on June 17.

faqs.q: Does AquaTerra run yoga and dance workshops for children?
faqs.a: Yes. Pose and Peace, a yoga workshop, ran in Howrah on June 23, 2023. Move and Groove, a dance workshop, ran at Sree Sree Gauranga Gaudiya Mission Sevashram on June 6, and Step to Sound, singing and dancing, ran at Telltula Ashram on June 8.
